sources.label: Wikipedia, "58 Hydrae"
sources.quote: 58 Hydrae, also named Solitaire, is a single star in the equatorial constellation of Hydra, located around 290 light years away from the Sun based on parallax.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 310 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,118 K, so 34.657 solar radii.

sources.quote: It has the Bayer designation E Hydrae; 58 Hydrae is the Flamsteed designation − a later designation of 6 Librae.
